reuse.why: Reuses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages, isTrackingBudget and the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser instead of hand-parsing #fixed.

duplication.why: The three copied hidden-category queries and the copyPreviousMonth hidden check collapse into one getMonthWideActionCategories selection; only the pre-existing per-action income guard remains repeated.

placement.why: The eligibility rule and the new action live in server/budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the month-wide actions, the new handler registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: One documented selection function with a single explicit includeHiddenCategories parameter and a shared MonthWideActionArgs type makes future rule changes a one-place edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions, including copyPreviousMonth (via the eligible id set) and the new setLastMonthSpending, go through getMonthWideActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is re-expressed in another shape; the copies are replaced by one helper.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideActionCategories gains only the includeHiddenCategories parameter the request names; no special-case branches or bypassing callers.
